__note: Reviewed rename worklist for bmx-mountain (PLAN §5 campaign). BMX MOUNTAIN's entry chunk assets/index-gCVK5XnX.js is a minified custom Vite production build (three.js r186 merged in), so the top-level bindings are the minifier's own short names. This worklist renames the chunk's PROGRAM-SCOPE bindings that are identifiable from the code's own evidence: the physics config object, the math/utility helpers (read straight out of the merged `var` declaration), the TSL node aliases (`X = K.vec3` etc. — the three.js TSL namespace `K` itself is declared in the vendor band and stays), the game's enums/tables (surface, ride mode, trick, deer colours, foliage, gamepad, opcodes, CSS tokens, bone map) and the named geometry/DOM/colour helpers. Every rule is evidence-based: the note in __evidence names the declaration this rule was authored from (line numbers refer to readable/assets/index-gCVK5XnX.pretty.js at the 2026-10-13 capture). Locals inside function bodies and the vendor three.js region are NOT candidates (the campaign renames top-level bindings only; the vendor band is wholeFile and never rewritten). tools/apply-names.mjs refuses collisions, shorthand positions, foreign (import/export) positions and chained renames; tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs records what fired; tools/verify-rename.mjs + tools/check-chunk.mjs prove the result.
